snippet.title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult - Announcement Trailer | Co-Op Cooking Horror
snippet.description:
🍔Wishlist Happy's Humble Burger Cult on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453910/
📅Coming on JULY 16th

🚨To celebrate the reveal, we are GIVING AWAY the previous game in the series, Happy's Humble Burger Farm, on Steam! Grab it before June 15th to keep it forever: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433340/Happys_Humble_Burger_Farm/

The original cooking horror returns in an unhinged co-op experience for 1-4 players. Grill burgers with your friends, serve customers, and hit your quota before the restaurant kitchen turns into a nightmare. When Asset Joy begins her hunt, try to escape alive with your hard-earned cash.

Burger Cult is a mix of horror and chaotic fun, where virtuoso burger flipping coexists with incidents caused by sheer incompetence.

🌐Follow the game on social media:
X: https://x.com/HappysHumble
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@UCa8CVIZjjupmTHx1Y6wFEGw

👥Join the Happy's Humble community: 
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/happyshumble
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/HappysHumbleSubreddit/
